south-kaibab-gc-az.headline: Flash flood closures below the rim (Aug 29)
south-kaibab-gc-az.body: Flash flooding on Aug 29 closed the Black Bridge and all of Phantom Ranch until further notice; the NPS air-evacuated about 50 people from the Phantom Ranch area. South Kaibab Trail is open from the trailhead down to the Black Bridge, but there is no river crossing and no access to Phantom Ranch or the North Kaibab Trail. The South Rim moves to Stage 4 water restrictions Aug 31 — overnight lodging closes and inner-canyon water availability is limited. Check the NPS closure page before you go.
south-kaibab-gc-az.source_name: NPS Grand Canyon — Critical Updates and Closures

bright-angel-trail-gc-az.headline: Flash flood closures below the rim (Aug 29)
bright-angel-trail-gc-az.body: Flash flooding on Aug 29 closed Phantom Ranch, Bright Angel Campground, and both river bridges until further notice; the NPS air-evacuated about 50 people from the Phantom Ranch area. Bright Angel Trail is open from the trailhead down to River Resthouse only — no river crossing, no Phantom Ranch access. The South Rim moves to Stage 4 water restrictions Aug 31 — overnight lodging closes and resthouse water may be limited. Check the NPS closure page before you go.
bright-angel-trail-gc-az.source_name: NPS Grand Canyon — Critical Updates and Closures

hermit-trail-gc-az.headline: Inner-canyon flash flood closures (Aug 29)
hermit-trail-gc-az.body: Flash flooding on Aug 29 closed the inner-canyon corridor until further notice — all of Phantom Ranch, the entire North Kaibab Trail, and both river bridges. Hermit Trail itself is not listed in the closure, but the South Rim moves to Stage 4 water restrictions Aug 31 (overnight lodging closes) and flash-flood risk continues in side canyons after storms. Check the NPS closure page before you go.
hermit-trail-gc-az.source_name: NPS Grand Canyon — Critical Updates and Closures
